'''Barthalemew Windsloe''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] and [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] sympathizer who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He pretended to be a wealthy playboy on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Sabaok]] around [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and used 'friendly' card games with [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] officers to learn information about the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Biography==
By [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] Windsloe lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Sabaok]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] and became a key figure among the social elite there. He would regularly spend his evenings in exclusive clubs, where he would play card games against [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] officers. The officers would sometimes discuss military and political matters and Windsloe would note down anything useful to the Alliance that he heard. He would compile this information into periodic reports and then beam them to a cargo [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] that made weekly runs through Ord Sabaok. The freighter's [[Captain/Legends|captain]] would then pass this information on to [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]].<ref name="CRO" />

==Personality and traits==
Winsloe was handsome, charming and vain, which made him popular among the social elites of Ord Sabaok. He was also a good listener and a great joker. However, he was also more serious and intelligent than he let on to his Imperial companions.<ref name="CRO" />

==Skills and abilities==
As a full-time gambler Windsloe was quite skilled at both gambling and bluffing.<ref name="CRO" />

==Equipment==
Windlose was quite wealthy and had ready access to 25,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] that he used for gambling. Befitting a playboy he had several suits of the most fashionable clothing and he always carried around a [[Sabacc/Legends|Sabacc]] deck.<ref name="CRO" />

==Behind the scenes==
Barthalemew Windsloe was designed by [[Paul Sudlow]] for ''[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]'', a supplement for the ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' that was published by [[West End Games]] in [[1994]]. He was illustrated by [[Mike Vilardi]].
